name: byron-s-virtual-museum
description: Static WebGL museum experience dedicated to the work of Byron Galvez.

scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-artworks.js && node scripts/check-js-syntax.js && node scripts/smoke-test.js
scripts.format: prettier --check README.md CHANGELOG.md NOTICE.md .github/workflows/ci.yml eslint.config.js playwright.config.js scripts/check-js-syntax.js scripts/smoke-test.js scripts/validate-artworks.js tests/e2e/museum.spec.js docs/12-testing-and-validation.md docs/tables/performance-metrics.md docs/benchmarks/performance-report.md docs/benchmarks/*.json
scripts.format:write: prettier --write README.md CHANGELOG.md NOTICE.md .github/workflows/ci.yml eslint.config.js playwright.config.js scripts/check-js-syntax.js scripts/smoke-test.js scripts/validate-artworks.js tests/e2e/museum.spec.js docs/12-testing-and-validation.md docs/tables/performance-metrics.md docs/benchmarks/performance-report.md docs/benchmarks/*.json
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run lint && npm run test:e2e
